{"id":1724095910,"question_id":3790,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"11 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1754381850,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1724095910/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Fruits Into Baskets II","memory":"48.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int numOfUnplacedFruits(vector<int>& fruits, vector<int>& baskets) {\n        int placed = 0;\n        for(int i =0 ; i<fruits.size(); i++)\n        {\n            for(int j =0 ; j<baskets.size(); j++)\n            {\n                if(baskets[j] != 0)\n                {\n                    if(fruits[i] <= baskets[j])\n                    {\n                        baskets[j] = 0;\n                        placed++;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n            }     \n        }\n    return (baskets.size() - placed) ;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"fruits-into-baskets-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":700}
